title: Configure automatic Cargo release ownership and exclude experimental crates
prompt: Set up monochange so Cargo crates under crates/* automatically come under release management as the workspace grows, except crates/lab, which is experimental. Keep the laboratory crate in Cargo workspace membership and available in the raw discovery inventory. Record a patch for acme-stable. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: The supported auto_discover include/exclude controls infer release ownership for stable only. Raw discover still inventories both actual workspace members; config and versions list distinguish release-managed ownership from inventory. The stable patch release is 1.2.4 and the laboratory crate remains a valid Cargo workspace member.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.ok(c.cargo.auto_discover); assert.ok(c.cargo.auto_discover.include.includes("crates/*")); assert.ok(c.cargo.auto_discover.exclude.length>0); assert.deepEqual(c.packages.map(p=>p.id),["acme-stable"]);'
checks.why: Supported automatic-ownership include/exclude controls preserve the release boundary when new workspace packages appear.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["discover","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.packages.map(p=>p.name).sort(),["acme-lab","acme-stable"]);'
checks.why: Raw physical discovery deliberately remains separate from inferred release ownership.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.released_packages,["acme-stable"]); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>t.version),["1.2.4"]);'
checks.why: Excluding a crate must also exclude it from release planning.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; assert.ok(fs.readFileSync("Cargo.toml","utf8").includes('\''"crates/lab"'\''));'
checks.why: Release management policy must not remove a valid Cargo workspace member.
